SOUNDTRACKS

Original Music Across Genres and Mediums

Explore two distinct musical journeys: cinematic Score Reel compositions for film and media, and the ever-evolving Music for the People—an immersive musical web experience that transforms across moods and moments. From orchestral drama to genre-bending rock, these are soundtracks that find their own home.

Score Reel

Cinematic Compositions

Musical compositions for film, games, and commercials. From high-energy car commercials to epic documentary trailers, these tracks showcase orchestral, electronic, and hybrid scoring techniques. Each composition is crafted to elevate the visual story—whether that means building tension, delivering emotional impact, or driving adrenaline.

Music for the People

A Morphing Musical Experience

An immersive web experience where music and visuals transform across three distinct moods: Chill, Dance Party, and Strange. What makes it unique? Each mode features curated tracks with dynamic theming that evolves the entire aesthetic in real-time, the new interface revealing new musical video content.
